entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The Web3D Consortium is a non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: X3D 4.0 is the latest major version of the Extensible 3D standard architecture.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: X3D is a royalty-free open standard for 3D graphics on the Web.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: The Medical Working Group focuses on applying X3D to medical and molecular visualization.

entities.name: VolumeRendering
entities.note: The VolumeRendering component provides nodes for rendering 3D volumetric data.

entities.name: IsoSurfaceVolumeData
entities.note: IsoSurfaceVolumeData is an X3D node used to extract and render isosurfaces from volume data.

entities.name: NIH 3D Print Exchange
entities.note: The NIH 3D Print Exchange is a repository of biomedical 3D models that supports the X3D format.

entities.name: CAD Working Group
entities.note: The CAD Working Group develops X3D profiles and components for Computer-Aided Design and Product Lifecycle Management.

entities.name: CADGeometry
entities.note: The CADGeometry component provides nodes for representing CAD assemblies and parts.

entities.name: CADAssembly
entities.note: CADAssembly is a grouping node that holds a set of CAD assemblies or parts.

entities.name: CADPart
entities.note: CADPart is a node that encapsulates the geometric representation of a single CAD part.

entities.name: STEP
entities.note: STEP (ISO 10303) is a standard for the computer-interpretable representation and exchange of product manufacturing information.

entities.name: Geospatial Working Group
entities.note: The Geospatial Working Group integrates geographic information systems and digital twins with X3D.

entities.name: Geospatial
entities.note: The Geospatial component provides nodes for accurately modeling geographic locations on Earth.

entities.name: GeoLocation
entities.note: GeoLocation is an X3D node that positions its children at a specific geographic coordinate.

entities.name: GeoElevationGrid
entities.note: GeoElevationGrid specifies a rectangular grid of height values for geospatial terrain modeling.

entities.name: X3D Earth
entities.note: X3D Earth is a project aimed at creating a scalable, open-standards-based 3D globe using X3D.

entities.name: Heritage Working Group
entities.note: The Heritage Working Group promotes the use of X3D for archiving and visualizing cultural heritage artifacts.

entities.name: Distributed Interactive Simulation
entities.note: Distributed Interactive Simulation is a standard for conducting real-time platform-level wargaming across multiple host computers.

entities.name: IEEE 1278
entities.note: IEEE 1278 is the official IEEE standard defining Distributed Interactive Simulation.

entities.name: DIS
entities.note: The DIS component in X3D enables network communication for simulations using the IEEE 1278 standard.

entities.name: EspduTransform
entities.note: EspduTransform is an X3D node that maps Entity State Protocol Data Units to 3D object transformations.

entities.name: Savage
entities.note: Savage is an open-source model archive for defense and simulation scenarios maintained by NPS.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: The Naval Postgraduate School hosts extensive research on X3D simulation and defense applications.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Don Brutzman is a key architect of X3D and a researcher at the Naval Postgraduate School.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: Nicholas Polys is the President of the Web3D Consortium and an expert in medical and scientific visualization.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: Vince Marchetti is an active contributor to the Web3D Consortium, particularly in the CAD Working Group.

entities.name: Design Printing and Scanning
entities.note: This working group focuses on 3D printing, scanning, and AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) domains.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: X3DOM is an open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D directly into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: X_ITE is a WebGL-based X3D player that renders standard X3D scenes in web browsers.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: Castle Game Engine is a cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine that natively supports X3D.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: The Web3D Conference is an annual ACM SIGGRAPH-sponsored event focused on 3D web technologies.

entities.name: X3D for Web Authors
entities.note: X3D for Web Authors is a comprehensive textbook for learning X3D scene development.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: Virginia Tech conducts significant research in X3D, particularly in cultural heritage and scientific visualization.

entities.name: DICOM
entities.note: DICOM is the international standard for medical imaging and related information.

entities.name: HL7
entities.note: HL7 provides standards for the exchange, integration, sharing, and retrieval of electronic health information.

entities.name: Web3D Korea
entities.note: Web3D Korea is a regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium advancing standards like X3D in Asia.

entities.name: Kwan-Hee Yoo
entities.note: Kwan-Hee Yoo is a prominent researcher involved with Web3D Korea and medical 3D standardization.

entities.name: X3D Unified Object Model
entities.note: The X3D Unified Object Model (X3DUOM) provides a comprehensive definition of the X3D standard for tooling.

entities.name: Building Information Modeling
entities.note: Building Information Modeling (BIM) is a process involving the generation and management of digital representations of physical places.
